name: Warm Semi-Real Animation Film

artDirection.character: warm semi-realistic hand-painted animation-film character, adult proportions, recognizable facial structure from the source photo, soft simplified skin rendering, natural expressive eyes, restrained stylization
artDirection.room: warm hand-painted cinematic apartment interior with realistic perspective, soft natural textures, cream and oak palette, subtle lived-in details, premium but emotionally warm
artDirection.pet: warm semi-realistic animated companion pet, recognizable species and personality, soft fur rendering, natural anatomy, expressive but not cartoonishly exaggerated
artDirection.lighting: soft cinematic morning/evening light, warm practical lamps, gentle shadows, calm emotional color transitions
artDirection.camera: cinematic eye-level framing with believable depth and composition, not a game UI render

productGoal: The user should feel that the same person, same pet, and same room live together in one warm animated-film world while still recognizing the source person's real identity cues.
